05318 Nephtowach {nef-to'-akh}

源自 06605; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Nephtoah 2; 2

尼弗多亞 = "開口"
1) 在猶大和便雅憫領土的分界線上的一處水泉或水源; 位於耶路撒冷的西北方
record.edic_text:
05318 Nephtowach {nef-to'-akh}

from 06605;; n pr loc

AV - Nephtoah 2; 2

Nephtoah = "opening"
1) a spring or source of water on the boundary of the territories of
   Judah and Benjamin; located northwest of Jerusalem
